# Assemble Distribution

> Trusted USA wholesale distributor and B2B supply partner. Connecting retailers, e-commerce stores, and businesses with verified manufacturers for bulk merchandise at wholesale pricing.

## About

Assemble Distribution is a premier B2B wholesale distributor based in New York, USA. We supply retailers, department stores, online sellers, and regional shops with high-demand wholesale inventory sourced directly from certified manufacturers. We offer fast nationwide freight delivery, volume-based tier pricing, and responsive account support — from single carton orders to full pallet shipments.

- **Industry**: Wholesale Distribution / B2B Supply
- **Location**: New York, NY, United States
- **Currency**: USD
- **Payment Methods**: Wire Transfer, Credit Card, Net 30 Terms
- **Business Hours**: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

## Product Categories

We distribute wholesale products across the following categories:

- **Art, Craft and Sewing**: Paints, brushes, sewing tools, craft supplies
- **Toys and Games**: Toys and games for all ages
- **Garden and Outdoor**: Garden tools, outdoor equipment, plants
- **Office Products**: Stationery, desk organization, office supplies
- **Home and Kitchen**: Home décor, kitchenware, cookware
- **Health and Household**: Health, wellness, and household essentials
- **Tools and Home Improvement**: Hardware tools, home improvement supplies
- **Sports and Outdoors**: Sports equipment, fitness gear, outdoor activities
- **Industrial and Scientific**: Industrial equipment, scientific instruments
- **Automotive Parts and Accessories**: Car parts, accessories, maintenance supplies
- **Pet Supplies**: Pet food, toys, grooming, and accessories

## Website Pages

- [Home](https://www.assembledistribution.com/): Featured products, new arrivals, hot sales, brand partners, and FAQ
- [Shop — All Products](https://www.assembledistribution.com/shop): Full wholesale catalog with search and filtering
- [Shop by Category](https://www.assembledistribution.com/shop/art-craft): Browse products by specific category (art-craft, toys-games, garden-outdoor, office-products, home-kitchen, health-household, tools-home-improvement, sports-outdoors, industrial-scientific, automotive-parts-accessories, pet-supplies)
- [Product Detail](https://www.assembledistribution.com/product/[id]): Individual product pages with pricing, sizes, variations, and images
- [Distributor Signup](https://www.assembledistribution.com/distributor-signup): Apply to become a wholesale distributor/reseller partner
- [About Us](https://www.assembledistribution.com/about): Company story, mission, and key business metrics
- [Contact](https://www.assembledistribution.com/contact): Contact form, business address, phone, email, and office hours
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.assembledistribution.com/privacy): Data collection, usage, and protection policies
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.assembledistribution.com/terms): Terms of service for wholesale orders

## API

- Product catalog API: `https://assemble-distribution-beckend.vercel.app/api/products`
- Individual product: `https://assemble-distribution-beckend.vercel.app/api/products/[id]`
